Team,

I sketched an initial RSVP lifecycle for the Engineer track on Sept 15 (45m session, focus: inference cost/perf tradeoffs). Attached: audience_segments_v2.csv and copy_variants.docx. High-level asks: 
- Confirm the target segments we should prioritize (primary: infra/platform engineers at midmarket + startups; secondary: ML/Model infra leads).
- Agree on reminder cadence (initial invite, 3-day reminder, 1-day reminder, day-of 2-hour push).
- Share final tracking link pattern and HubSpot campaign id so we can instrument channel attribution.

Questions I want resolved by EOD Wed so we can lock the creative and schedule.

Proposed triggers:
- RSVP click (yes) -> send calendar invite + thank-you email immediately
- No response at 72 hours -> reminder variant A/B test
- Clicked RSVP but didn’t complete form -> 24-hour recovery email

Notes: aiming for an engineer-friendly subject & plain text preview for the first touch. See attachment for recommended lists and an early draft of copy variants.

Thanks,

Love the approach. A few operational notes based on past engineer-targeted webinars:
- Send windows: schedule primary sends at 08:45 PT, reminders at 3 days later (11:00 PT), and a 1-day reminder at 09:00 PT. For EU folks, stagger with a separate list and send at 09:00 BST.
- Split: 60/40 priority: infra/platform (60%) vs ML infra (40%). Keep the A/B subject split only on the primary send.
- Automation: HubSpot workflow should add a 24-hour automated calendar invite if a user marks Yes. If they mark Maybe, assign to AE outbox for follow-up (template included).

I uploaded a draft send schedule (send_schedule.xlsx) to the shared drive and added timezones. Also: request to ops to shorten the RSVP form to 4 fields (name, company, role, how likely to attend) to reduce friction.

Laura
Demand Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
